rationale: The real GT thread centers on dsocek questioning whether the naming/mapping fix is comprehensive (suggesting driving it from packed_modules_mapping) and tthakkal responding by removing that companion change to keep the PR SDXL-only. Y's top finding (the reverted to_out.0 WeightsMapper at manager.py:309, tied to commit ac3a2ce5) directly reconstructs this exact history and flags it as an open, unconfirmed gap — a strong recall/precision hit. X notices the same revert but confidently declares it 'correctly reverted, good call, don't reinstate,' which reads as a dismissal of the very concern the real reviewers left unresolved, and X also asserts '_lora_components has zero users in the entire repo,' which Y directly contradicts with a concrete counter-example (pipeline_sensenova_u1.py:543) — a clear factual error hurting X's precision. X is more conventionally formatted and has slightly crisper actionable suggestions across more findings, but several (FF-layer remap, text-encoder LoRA failure) are unverifiable speculative extensions beyond PR scope, while Y's sparser findings are each backed by explicit grep verification and quoted evidence. Neither includes a LATENT GAP CHECK section.
